subject: Mitochondrial Microproteins Link Mediterranean Diet to Cellular Resilience
script: From Agewell Brief: Mitochondrial Microproteins Link Mediterranean Diet to Cellular Resilience. Researchers at USC reveal how specific dietary patterns modulate humanin and SHMOOSE, driving a retrograde signaling cascade that shields vascular and neural tissues from oxidative decay. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
